lines: Ai dard, bata, kuchh tu hi pata

lines: Hum mein hai dil-e-betaab nihaan, hum mein hai dil-e-betaab nihaan

couplets.en: Does a restless heart lie hidden in us, or are we ourselves that restless heart?

lines: Khamosh khada hoon saahil par
Main hairat-o-hasrat ka maara
couplets.en: I stand silent on the shore, overcome by wonder and longing.

Darya-e-mohabbat kehta hai, aa, kuchh bhi nahin, paayaab hain hum

lines: Laakhon hi musaafir chalte hain

lines: Manzil pe pahunchte hain do ek, laakhon hi, laakhon hi musaafir chalte hain
Manzil pe pahunchte hain do ek, ahl-e-zamaana, qadr karo
couplets.en: Of the hundreds of thousands who set out, only one or two arrive, so give them their due.

lines: Ai ahl-e-zamaana, qadr karo, naayaab na hon, kamyaab hain hum
Dhoondoge agar mulkon mulkon
couplets.en: People of this age, give us our due, for you will seldom find our like however far you search.

lines: Murghaan-e-qafas ko phoolon ne

lines: Murghaan-e-qafas ko phoolon ne

lines: Aa jao jo tum ko aana ho

couplets.en: Come, if you wish to come.
